{{Quote|The Rebels are rumored to have hidden among the Dantari on Dantooine. Specifically with a tribe called the Janta. We believe that when the Rebels evacuated the area, this ship was among those used. There may be information at the Janta Stronghold... retrieve it.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Velso]]|<ref name="SWG:LV">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|Corellian Corvette Pre-Quest: "Lt. Velso"}}</ref>}}
The '''Janta Stronghold''' was a fortified system of caves settled by the the [[Dantari]] of the [[Janta]] tribe on the planet [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:JS" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a band of Janta looking for food attacked an artisan near their cave and stole a couple of his sculptures.<ref name="SWG:AC">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|A commoner|Dantooine}}</ref> The same year, [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Velso]] dispatched a spacer to the Janta Stronghold in order to retrieve the ship destruct sequence codes of a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Corellian Corvette]]. The Empire suspected that the codes were lost during the evacuation of the [[Dantooine base/Legends|Dantooine Rebel base]] in which the ship participated.<ref name="SWG:LV" /> Later, a spacer visited the cave and collected a [[Blackscale "Hall Sweeper" carbine/Legends|Blackscale "Hall Sweeper" carbine]].<ref name="SWG:RCWMI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Rare Carbine Weapons Mark I}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Janta Stronghold was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:JS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
